name: Appartement Schöpf
beschreibung: The Appartement Schöpf is located in Sölden in the Ötztal. The holiday apartment is designed for self-catering. A fully equipped kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms are included. The location in a residential area provides a quiet environment. The valley stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkoglbahn cable cars are nearby. Guests can enjoy activities in both winter and summer. Free parking spaces are available at the house.
